::: text
My background spans upstream process development, synthetic biology, and metabolic engineering, paired with a deep understanding of statistics/bioinformatics (MS Statistics; Postdoc in Environmental Biostatistics). I have wet-lab research experience across biopharma (Bristol Myers Squibb, Takeda), academic (UT Austin, MIT), and startup (BioReNuva) environments. I have worked across bacterial, yeast, and mammalian cell lines.

At BioReNuva I developed the company's first fed-batch bioreactor process and led its transfer to manufacturing. My doctoral work in the Alper lab centered on the oleaginous yeast *Yarrowia lipolytica*: I developed Golden Gate based genome editing and promoter library screening, performed adaptive laboratory evolution to raise tolerance to industrial waste streams, and integrated CFD modeling of high-oil-density fermentations. 

I'm **open to relocation nationwide** and am available to start within 30 days.

<script>
(function () {
  var detail = document.getElementById("chip-detail");
  var chips = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".chip"));
  if (!detail || !chips.length) return;

  var HINT = detail.innerHTML;
  var pinned = null;

  function render(chip) {
    if (chip) {
      detail.innerHTML = chip.getAttribute("data-hl");
      detail.classList.remove("is-hint");
    } else {
      detail.innerHTML = HINT;
      detail.classList.add("is-hint");
    }
  }

  function pin(chip) {
    pinned = chip;
    chips.forEach(function (c) {
      c.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(c === chip));
    });
    render(chip);
  }

  chips.forEach(function (chip) {
    chip.addEventListener("mouseenter", function () {
      if (!pinned) render(chip);
    });
    chip.addEventListener("mouseleave", function () {
      if (!pinned) render(null);
    });
    chip.addEventListener("focus", function () {
      if (!pinned) render(chip);
    });
    chip.addEventListener("blur", function () {
      if (!pinned) render(null);
    });
    chip.addEventListener("click", function () {
      pin(pinned === chip ? null : chip);
    });
  });

  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && pinned) pin(null);
  });
})();
</script>
